# Slovo

> Slovo is a speech-to-text app for iPhone and iPad (runs on Apple silicon Macs too). Recognition happens on the device itself, so audio and text never leave it: no account, no uploads, no internet needed after the model is downloaded.

What it does: records audio or imports audio and video files (voice messages from chats, voice memos, videos, through the Share sheet), and turns speech into text with punctuation and timecodes. Text appears while you speak. 99 languages, detected automatically. Free tier with a monthly amount of recognition; Slovo Pro subscription removes the limits and allows recordings and files up to 4 hours.

Facts: iOS 18 or later. App Store id 6812518848. The site is available in 14 languages, each page lists its translations via hreflang.

## Pages

- [Home](https://slovo.byles.app/): what Slovo does, how it works, pricing, comparison with cloud transcription services
- [Privacy policy](https://slovo.byles.app/privacy.html): what data the app handles and what it never sends anywhere
- [Support](https://slovo.byles.app/support.html): how to reach the developer, ideas and bug reports
- [Terms of use](https://slovo.byles.app/terms.html)
- [Open-source licenses](https://slovo.byles.app/licenses.html): the models and libraries the app is built on
